info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Fooddelivery Deliveries Drivers-v3-spec
info.description: The Food Delivery Driver Listings API enables businesses to retrieve a comprehensive list of drivers engaged in food deliveries. This endpoint provides vital information about each driver's availability, performance, and assignments, supporting operations in logistics and workforce management. Typical consumers include food delivery platforms and logistics providers seeking to optimize driver allocation and client service. Developers can leverage this API to enhance resource planning and improve the customer experience.

get.summary: Retrieve Deliveries for a Specific Driver
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the list of deliveries assigned to a specific driver. Use this to track the deliveries and manage routes efficiently.
